d:
Three decades into her performing journey, Anoushka Shankar set out on a long-awaited new chapter in 2026: her first-ever tour of Latin America.
Captured from within the crowd in Curitiba, Brazil, this moment offers a glimpse of the raw energy of the tour through the eyes of those who were there.
Video: Neto Timm, Rec Out Studio
Band: Arun Ghosh, Tom Farmer, Yusuf Ahmed
Sound Engineers: James ‘Slim’ Campbell, John Duckett
Sitar Tech: Tommy Khosla
Management: Saloni Thakkar
